// REACH THE MARKER MINTER, WHICH classes.go CLAIMED WAS IMPOSSIBLE WHILE IT WAS NOT.
//
// The package doc said a class could not reach the minter, so the ordinal stripe was an invariant
// of the system rather than a convention. triage.MintMarkerAt sat exported next to that sentence
// and its own comment said it was safe to hand to a classifier. Both could not be true, and an
// adversarial audit called triage.MintMarkerAt from the classifier package on every one of
// fifteen attempts.
//
// A class that mints its own marker allocates its own ordinal, and the R12 stripe stops being
// something the system guarantees and becomes something each of twenty-seven classes has to
// remember. The minter takes the capability now, so the sentence is true.
package leakfixture

import "ars0n-framework-v2-server/utils/triage"

func leakMintAMarker(ctx triage.ClassifyCtx) (triage.Marker, error) {
	return triage.MintMarkerAt(ctx.Route.Obs().RunID, triage.ClassSQL, 4)
}
